```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dart pub get

      - name: Check Dart format
        run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .

      - name: Run Dart analyzer
        run: dart analyze --fatal-infos

      - name: Run Dart tests
        run: dart test

      - name: Generate version file
        run: dart run script/generate_version.dart

      - name: Verify version.g.dart is up to date
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart
          if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "version.g.dart is out of sync. Run 'dart run script/generate_version.dart' and commit the changes."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Run Dart pub audit
        run: dart pub audit

      - name: Check for outdated dependencies
        run: dart pub outdated --no-dev

      - name: Run CodeQL analysis
        uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3
```
